answer: To secure the canyon network, we implement a quadratic slashing scheme coupled with a comet zero-knowledge verifiable delay function that escalates marginal attack costs super-linearly. This mechanism ensures that any adversarial entity attempting to spin up Sybil clusters across our juniper validator nodes faces a catastrophic, non-linear loss of collateral. By tying the penalization to the square of correlated failures, the expected utility of an exploit remains negative, cementing a robust Nash equilibrium.
